messages:
sanjay: Heads-up — starting intake for a new model: Orion-8B (dense 8B, FP16 baseline). Need catalog entry, model card, quant experiments (INT8 / 4-bit AWQ/GPTQ), eval matrix (MMLU/BBQ/TruthfulQA + our internal prompt suites), perf baselines on the A100/H100 dev pool, and an announcement + canary rollout plan. Who can pick up what? :wave:

maria: I can own the model card and the catalog entry. Will draft the model-card and a short README with sample prompts. ETA Wed EOD. :memo:

alex: I'll take quant experiments. Plan to try AWQ-4 and GPTQ-int8 runs, then compare latency/quality tradeoffs. Need the 2k instruction eval set and the hallucination prompts — can someone point me to the datasets? :mag:

sanjay: @alex — use /datasets/benchmarks/2025-internal-suite (includes hallucination + safety prompts). Baselines to compare against: our Onyx-7B and Nova-7B QA/LLM metrics. Cost target: <=1.2x token cost vs Onyx for same quality.

kevin: I'll set up the infra for canary. Proposal: 5% traffic, 12h health window, automatic fallback to onyx-7b. Will add RBAC flags for private tenants. Draft config below:
```
route: /v1/models/orion-8b/canary
traffic: 0.05
health_checks: 5m
fallback: onyx-7b
canary_duration: 12h
```

june: I'll prepare SDK examples and an announcement draft for #announcements. We should call out the recommended quantized variant (if quality delta <=1%) and expected latency on h100/a100.

maria: Draft of model catalog entry (first pass):
```
{
  "name": "orion-8b",
  "family": "orion",
  "size": "8B",
  "baseline": "fp16",
  "recommended_quant": ["awq-4", "gptq-int8"],
  "perf_profiles": {"a100": "~18ms/token", "h100": "~12ms/token"},
  "tags": ["instruction-tuned", "open-checkpoint"],
  "notes": "draft — includes internal evals and privacy review pending"
}
```

alex: quick operational note — AWQ-4 looks promising for latency but we must watch for instruction-following degradation on some RLHF prompts. I'll run alignment/regression evals and post the deltas in a table.

eval-bot: scheduled eval job 1787402000-orion-8b-mml-qa; results ETA ~4h :gear:

kevin: Opening infra PR now. Will add the canary route + quota config and a feature flag for private tenants. GH PR: gh-4829. Adding smoke tests to the canary flow.

june: Announcement draft relies on legal sign-off for the model card (data sources + license). Pinging legal for review. Once legal clears, I'll post in #announcements with recommended SDK snippets and rollout timeline. :eyes:

sanjay: Great — owners summary: maria = model card + catalog, alex = quant + evals, kevin = canary + infra, june = docs + announcement. I'll track progress in the onboarding checklist doc and schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:30 PT. Please drop short updates here or link PRs/eval outputs. :calendar:

maria: ack — will post the draft link and a short checklist (model card, biases, data sources, quant recommendations).

alex: starting quant runs now; will post a comparison table (fp16 vs awq-4 vs gptq-int8) with latency and MMLU deltas.

kevin: infra PR opened and smoke tests added. Will tag @sre for routing review.

june: announcement draft uploaded to /docs/announcements/orion-8b-draft.md — pinged legal.

sanjay: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the source of truth for the Orion-8B bring-up. If any blocker appears (quality regression >2% or quant instability), we pause canary until root cause. :rocket:
